instruction: Read full HANDOFF.md and DESIGN.md. Deduplicate, write local claimed, fixed checkout in independent directory. A: recompile unchanged T025 second-round raw drafts. B: certified native physical evaluation with verified existing optical data and explicit grid, freeze prediction then observe goals. Optional zero-new-eval cache check. C: one original-metered-planner revision using actual physical observations, at most one contract repair. D: explicitly compute revised candidates within shared numerical budget, report and stop. If no valid observations, stop before paid revision. No new question/retrieval/download/PDF parsing/ablations/full regression/experience database/dependency installation/model upgrade.

budget.model_gate: Only original configured local model/metered planner and ledgers; verify current prices and reserve; no cloud project paid key.
budget.numerical_budget: 64 across both rounds, not per round; subtract already started new evaluations before round2; report internal verification and Workbench forward-call counting separately.

expected_outputs: Candidate acceptance/rejection and evidence downgrade report with original raw hashes unchanged
Per-route G1/G2, spectra and physics verification for round1 and explicit round2
One honest prediction-observation-revision-next-performance trajectory; no automatic same-name lineage inference
Cache hits/new evaluations, Workbench call scope, elapsed time, HTTP costs and liabilities
Actual model use of provided observations assessed separately from mere context injection
Fixed evidence commit and terminal receipt; stop

execution.validate_command: <ArticlePython> focused_research/route_stage.py validate --task-sheet <原task_sheet> --evidence-file <原evidence_items> --constraints-file <原design_constraints> --routes-file <T025第二轮原始routes> --output <新T026/compile>
execution.run_command: <ArticlePython> focused_research/scientific_stage.py run --task-sheet <原task_sheet> --evidence-file <原evidence_items> --constraints-file <原design_constraints> --routes-file <T025第二轮原始routes> --optical-media <已核实映射JSON> --wavelengths <网格JSON> --cache-dir <新T026/cache> --max-new-evals 14 --max-workers 2 --execute --output <新T026/round1>
execution.revise_entry: scientific_stage.main([revise, task/evidence/constraints paths, --previous-run <round1>, --execute, --output <revision>], planner=original_metered_planner); exact Python example in HANDOFF
execution.round2: Repeat run using revision/research_routes.json, same cache, fresh output; max-new-evals=64 minus all new certified evaluations already started.
execution.materials: Existing verified real material mapping/data only; preserve original targets,45deg,polarization; missing data blocks, no fictitious constants.
execution.grid: Explicit JSON numerical wavelengths including target-band endpoints/interior; suggested450-1000nm step1nm is sampling not continuum/manufacturing guarantee.

cloud_validation: 350 tests +6 subtests,15.52s,sockets disabled. Real TMM/process/cache plus injected fixture LLM, not Qwen. Root diff check and independent review fixes reported.
offline_historical_replay: T025 unchanged round2 newly compiles7 executable routes14 instances. Historical T025 acceptance remains0; no claim of scientific correctness.
implementation_limits: V2 MVP: per-route tolerance, certified process/cache execution, goal observations, frozen prediction, injected revision, explicit next calculation. Automatic gradients, optimizer and internal-field probes not wired. See DESIGN.md.
